references.text: Just as when you see clouds gathering, you know that rain is near; in the same way, when you see these signs, you should know that the end is near.
In the same way, when you see these things happening, you should know that the kingdom of God is near.
The observation of the righteous path and their ultimate peace can be compared to recognizing the signs of the times.
Just as the fruit of the Spirit are clear signs of spiritual life, so too are the signs Jesus mentioned evidence that the end times are approaching.
